mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 1 month and 5-day forward returns are positive in > 70% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for three consecutive months and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO rises > 1% MoM and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in one month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS falls > 100k in 1 month and 5-day forward returns are positive in > 70% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 2% month-over-month signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If both HOUST and RSAFS rise > 2% MoM and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 25 basis points in one month signals monetary easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS falls > 25bps in 1 month and 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during periods of low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2% YoY).
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: If GDPC1 rises for two consecutive quarters and CPIAUCSL < 2% YoY, but 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.
